_why: Radar's own view of which rule covers which corpus-2 class. The pack ships a mapping derived from radar's rule names at the time it was written, and it predates these rules - so without this every class below scores 'no-rule' forever and radar's internal regression under-reports its own coverage. Additions only: the pack's entries win where both name a class, and this file is never sent anywhere. The published ScannerTruth number is theirs and stays whatever their mapping says.
